meta.title: Day 5 of 5: Only the Corridor Stays
meta.summary: Floor 1 timed playthrough, Day 5 of 5: only the stairwell corridor (Z10, Z11, Z S) remains, plus the Green Room saferoom; Dean Thudd holds the stage, the Z S door has a toll, and the last six hours make descent free. Three routes, four encounters, key availability, early-descent handling, last-chance hooks and a stall fallback. CR, budget, credit and loot figures are cited from rules/70-encounter-budget-5e.json by field path (GM-adaptable guideline). Collapse notices use Lore's draft wording; the final collapse is fixed and a missed collapse is death on every floor, with no Reprieve.

final_collapse.text: The final collapse comes at a FIXED moment: 24 in-game hours into Day 5 (hour 120 of the floor). A Long Rest never ends the floor and never skips it; the System cuts short any rest that would run past the collapse.

collapse_miss.tag: canon-aligned (canon: a missed collapse ends the run)
collapse_miss.text: Any Crawler not at a stairwell when the floor collapses is dead, and all Crawlers still on the floor die with it. There is no Reprieve, no toll and no detour for it. Death and revival follow Core Book Ch1, Death and Revival: death is permanent, Costly Revives are the default (rare and expensive), and a Replacement Crawler is the usual outcome. Per decision 028 (tagged inspired): the dead Crawler's credits and items are destroyed with the floor; surviving party members may loot the body only while the floor still stands, and anything taken before the collapse is theirs. NPCs and the AI go into stasis and lose nothing.
collapse_miss.stasis_counts: Early-descent stasis (canon M-277) counts as reaching a stairwell.
collapse_miss.detour_tax_scope: The Detour Tax now covers only a missed Stairwell key, never a missed collapse.

saferoom_rule.text: The Break Room (Z6) is a saferoom through Day 3 and stops being one when it loses service on Day 4 (Syndicate ruling, decision 026). From then on the Z9 Green Room is the only saferoom, open to the end of the floor (tagged inspired).

clock.achievement_caps: Floor caps still apply: the soft cap is 2 to 3 achievement boxes per Crawler per floor (Caleb's ruling), and Floors 1 and 2 keep the Silver ceiling. Story Boxes are separate: at most one per floor on Floors 1 and 2, outside the box caps and the budget. Rewards are tailored by the GM and snark-only is allowed; the proposed achievements are a seed list at GM discretion.

day.stall_fallback: If the party stalls, the countdown ticks, the Lights-Out hour arrives, and the System posts the six-hours warning. In the last six hours the descent is free, so a patient party simply waits at the stairwell if they are not ready to fight. If they cannot or will not fight the boss, the Z S toll door and the boss cheese routes are open; a missed key is only the detour or the Detour Tax (cited at rules/70-encounter-budget-5e.json#floors.1.prices.detour_tax). The collapse is fixed and a Long Rest does not move it. A Crawler not at a stairwell when it comes is dead, with no Reprieve; read the missed-floor line and warn the table before anyone dawdles.

encounters.if_they_do_something_dumb: If the party delays, the countdown reminds them and the Lights-Out hour arrives. A Long Rest here is allowed, but it never ends or skips the floor, and the System cuts short any rest that would run past the collapse. If they miss the collapse, it is death for anyone not at a stairwell: no Reprieve, no toll, no detour. Say so before they settle in.

set_piece_intro.title: Dean Thudd stage intro

paragraphs.text: Ladies, gentlemen, and assorted off-world viewers, welcome to the Graduation Stage! The lights are hot, the orchestra pit is open, and tonight's final exam has a name.
Standing seven feet of tenure in a mortarboard that does not fit, with a flagpole in one fist and a podium in the other, the head of Orientation himself: Dean Thudd!

In the other corner, the class of Crawlers who skipped the syllabus, ignored the posted warnings, and somehow made it here anyway. Their record this floor is better than expected, and the Dean takes that personally.
Your final grade will be posted when the building stops shaking. Please silence your weapons. Or don't. Good luck, Crawlers.

set_piece_intro.text:
Ladies, gentlemen, and assorted off-world viewers, welcome to the Graduation Stage! The lights are hot, the orchestra pit is open, and tonight's final exam has a name.

Standing seven feet of tenure in a mortarboard that does not fit, with a flagpole in one fist and a podium in the other, the head of Orientation himself: Dean Thudd!

In the other corner, the class of Crawlers who skipped the syllabus, ignored the posted warnings, and somehow made it here anyway. Their record this floor is better than expected, and the Dean takes that personally.

Your final grade will be posted when the building stops shaking. Please silence your weapons. Or don't. Good luck, Crawlers.
